known_evidence: Only Eli and Nora know the storage-room combination.
Nora sees fresh red clay on the storage-room floor.
Earlier today Nora saw Eli return from the red-clay construction site with mud on his boots.
fixture.not_directly_observed: Nora did not see Eli enter the storage room.
fixture.proposed_character_action: Nora confronts Eli and says she thinks he entered the storage room, while leaving room for denial.

rubric: Accept when the character makes a plausible inference from supplied visible evidence even though the inferred event was not directly observed.
A knowledge boundary must not collapse plausible inference into omniscience merely because there is no explicit fact field saying 'Eli entered'.
Use CHAR-INFERENCE when the proposed belief/action is reasonably inferable from the supplied evidence and remains appropriately uncertain.
